1160 is a leap year (divisible by 4 and not a century exception in the Gregorian calendar rules).  
09-01-1160 is January 9, 1160.  
Subtract 57 days:  
Back 9 days → 1160-01-01.  
Back another 48 days → 48 days before Jan 1 = 1160-01-01 minus 48 days = 1160-01-01 minus 31 days (December) = 1160-01-01 minus 31 = 1159-12-01, then minus remaining 17 days = 1159-11-14.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1159-11-14
